text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On the day of her Debut race, Ikuno Dictus 
was composed as ever. While nervous, her 
stress management seemed to have paid off 
wonderfully.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A once-in-a-lifetime debut race. Promising 
to enjoy the run and return safe and 
sound, she steps forward to take on the 
challenge.
